fable_claim5_check.claim: REVIEW_2026-09-06_FABLE51 claim 5: a top-5-month share >= 0.8355 on a series with mean 0.28%/mo and sd 3.6% happens in 31% (normal) to 40% (t4) of pure-noise draws, so 'the baseline is five months' is not evidence of beta timing.

verdict_rule.LOADING: beta - 1 clears t >= 2 AND the beta-matched alpha's t < 2
verdict_rule.NEITHER: neither -- the excess is neither a demonstrable intercept nor a demonstrable loading on this much tape
verdict_rule.note: a LABEL on an arithmetic result, not a promotion gate. No book is promoted, sealed, ordered or deployed by this receipt.

one_sentence_answer: LOADING: lgbm_clf's beta is 1.1782 (t(beta-1) = 2.03 HAC, 3.778 OLS), and once that leverage is paid for its annualised excess falls from +0.0339 (t 1.225) against the raw VW market to +0.0113 (t 0.349 HAC) against the beta-matched leg at 10 bps and -0.0207 (t -0.644) at 25 bps -- an intercept indistinguishable from zero sitting on a market loading that is not. The 8-seed nn_pre_causal ensemble is the SAME shape and not the opposite: its beta is 1.3294 (t(beta-1) = 4.238 HAC), its only-net-VW-beating t of 2.243 against the raw market becomes +0.0395/yr at t 1.095 beta-matched at 10 bps and +0.0105/yr at t 0.292 at 25 bps, so its residual alpha is positive in every cell but clears nothing (DSR 0.1497 at a 40-cell family, MDE 0.06858/yr against a +0.0395 effect) -- it is the one book whose beta-matched excess is positive in all three eras.
